name: orchestrator
description: Autonomous multi-model orchestration for Claude Code: routes work to Haiku, Sonnet, Opus or Fable by task complexity, runs a plan-build-verify-review pipeline, enforces a model cost cap, and flags Claude Code releases and docs changes that need review.

max_tier.title: Highest model tier
max_tier.description: The most capable model subagents may run on. Spawns above it are refused with a suggestion to use a cheaper agent.

update_check.title: Check for Claude Code updates
update_check.description: Once a day, fetch the Claude Code changelog and docs index from code.claude.com and mention changes that affect this plugin.
